task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to make an attempt to travel north. With that done, ensure that the portal is open. And then, head north. Next, ensure that the gate is open. Then, try to go to the north. And then, ensure that the passageway in the cubicle is open. And then, go east. Then, make an attempt to move east. And then, pick up the sandwich from the floor of the canteen. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
description:
Guess what, you are in a place we're calling a cookery. You begin to take stock of what's in the room.

You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a platter. The platter is usual. But there isn't a thing on it.

There is an unguarded exit to the north.
